vid_idle_front
prompt:
Realistic full-body video of a man standing still in a relaxed natural idle pose, as a looping idle animation reference for a video game: weight shifts very slightly from one foot to the other, calm natural breathing visible in the chest and shoulders, arms hanging relaxed at his sides with a tiny natural sway, occasional natural blink, he looks straight ahead. He does not walk, talk, gesture or leave his spot. The last frame should match the first frame so the clip can loop.

The man must be EXACTLY the man in the reference image: same face, short dark hair, full dark beard, skin tone, age, build and proportions, wearing the same dark charcoal suit jacket, dark shirt, dark trousers and black leather shoes. Do not change his identity or clothing at any moment of the video.

Camera: completely static locked-off tripod shot, front view, camera at chest height, the whole body from head to shoes always in frame with margin, centered, no zoom, no pan.

Setting: empty seamless light-grey photo studio (cyclorama), flat uniform background, plain floor of the same grey, soft even diffuse lighting, no props, no other people, no text, no logos, no music video effects. Photorealistic, natural real motion, 24 fps look, sharp focus, no motion blur trails, no cuts, one continuous shot.
